program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((cyan-cells (filter (lambda (p) p)
                                      (for*/list ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
                                        (and (= (at g r c) 8) (list r c)))))
                  (r1 (reduce (lambda (a b) (if (< a b) a b))
                              (first (first cyan-cells))
                              (map first (rest cyan-cells))))
                  (c1 (reduce (lambda (a b) (if (< a b) a b))
                              (second (first cyan-cells))
                              (map second (rest cyan-cells))))
                  (r2 (reduce (lambda (a b) (if (> a b) a b))
                              (first (first cyan-cells))
                              (map first (rest cyan-cells))))
                  (c2 (reduce (lambda (a b) (if (> a b) a b))
                              (second (first cyan-cells))
                              (map second (rest cyan-cells)))))
             (cellmap g
                      (r c v)
                      (if (and (>= r r1) (<= r r2) (>= c c1) (<= c c2) (= v 1)) 3 v))))))
